text:
carla: FYI bringing up orion35b (int4) on canary and seeing intermittent cuda OOMs for multi-turn sessions >1500 tokens. ~1.5% rejects. anyone on call? :wave:

	ben: can you paste a tiny log?

	carla: log:```
	2026-04-01T07:12:01Z worker-9 ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory	alloc_chunk=1.3MB	free_slots=2	max_new_tokens=1024	microbatch=6	quant=int4
	```

	yuri: smells like fragmentation. int4 reduces model bytes but KV and attn scratch create many small allocs. quick actions: lower model default max_new_tokens -> 384, set microbatch_soft_cap -> 3, and reduce kv_evict_threshold to 0.6. also try freelist_coalesce=on for one canary worker.

	carla: started a canary with freelist_coalesce=on and the config changes. I'll watch histograms.

	eval-bot: quick eval snapshot: orion35b-int4 vs fp16 on translation-suite: BLEU -2.3 when max_new_tokens high. int8 close to fp16. artifact: gs://redwood-evals/orion35b/1767000000/summary.html

	ben: agree don't revert yet. route long-context chat to orion35b-int8 if ctx_estimate >1500. add routing rule to canary config.

	ops-bot: canary deploy record: orion35b-int4 v2026.04.01.07 deployed to pool-canary-7 (sha: c0ffee).

	yuri: early memory histograms: worker with freelist_coalesce shows lower peak free_slot variance and no OOMs after 40m. control still saw a single OOM. promising but need full eval.

	carla: plan: (1) yuri to collect full tracemalloc/nvprof dump (ETA 2h), (2) ben to push route rule for long contexts (ETA 30m), (3) eval-bot to run full quality sweep (ETA 3h). If BLEU delta >3 pts we'll fallback. update here with artifacts.

	ben: routing rule pushed to canary.

	eval-bot: kicked off sweeps; will deposit outputs to gs://redwood-evals/orion35b/1767000000/; will compare int4/int8/fp16.

	carla: thanks. monitoring alerts; paging enabled for >1% 5xx over 5m. reconvene after sweeps. :thumbsup:
